report:
Content Based Routing for several tables

Hi,
We have an oracle connector that streams 15 tables.
it is running on no_data snapshot mode and I want to do incremental/ad-hoc snapshots as needed. I would like to route snapshots to a different topic than the streaming topics.
In the below example, how do I specify the target topic 'updates' to a dynamic string as I'm using this transformation on 15 tables and each of those go into seprate topics?
For ex.
table1 -> streaming -> delta.table1 (topic)
table2 -> streaming -> delta.table2
....
table1 -> snapshot -> master.table1 (topic)
table2 -> snapshot -> master.table2
....
Do I have to add 15 transformations, one for each table, or can I use some regex in the target topic?
transforms.route.type=io.debezium.transforms.ContentBasedRouter
transforms.route.language=jsr223.groovy
transforms.route.topic.expression=value.op == 'u' ? 'updates' : null

evidence.quote: since blocking snapshots effectively build off the initial snapshot mechanism... it needs to likely align with the specifics around how \"table.include.list\" gets parsed & used, which currently does not support the database attribute." Reporter fixed by removing quoted DB name.

notes: Blocking snapshot captured no tables because the signal used the quoted db-qualified name; blocking snapshots match table.include.list semantics (no db part) by design, incremental requires it.
